provenance.note: Development results on one partition; reserved tests sealed.
provenance.instances_vs_distinct: a recording evaluated in several withheld-class runs counts once per run as an instance and once as a distinct recording

wording: an interval excluding zero supports a specific metric difference under this protocol, not an overall winner

bootstrap.scheme: stratified mixed-unit over the whole development pool (fault folders within class, normal recordings individually); one draw weights every run's recordings by their multiplicity, so recordings reused across withheld-class runs are resampled jointly

calibration_matched_operating_point.rule: per run, LR threshold = the m-th smallest LR −MSP of the calibration recordings, m = number of calibration recordings passing both CNN checks; accept iff ≤ (ties accepted)

a_seen_folder.label: RETROSPECTIVE and EXPLORATORY: thresholds matched on evaluation data; they must not be deployed or used for model selection

b_unseen_foldk.label: RETROSPECTIVE and EXPLORATORY: thresholds matched on evaluation data; they must not be deployed or used for model selection
